pages.quiz:
AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

4. When learning Ramp services, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Ramp services.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ramp services.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ramp services.

5. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

6. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.

7. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.

8. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.

9. When learning Flight Controls, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Flight Controls.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Controls.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Controls.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

11. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Navigation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Navigation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.

12. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Ramp services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Airfield Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hangar Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.

3. D — Information and Communication Technology

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.

5. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

6. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.

8. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.

9. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.

10. B — Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.

12. D — CPU
